leftLowerLeg.source: Existing gate bend/off-axis bounds preserved, normalized to signed local Cardan axes; former swing-twist differs from Cardan twist. 2026-10-15 T-pose-normalized 7-clip Cardan scan; thresholds extend initial engineering estimates to cover accepted existing motion (counterexamples are rejected for non-joint reasons).
